roles.functionStatement: Help land managers adopt conservation practices that protect soil, water and habitat on working lands.

x4.reviewStatus: unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person)

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Develop conservation plans with private landowners and deliver voluntary conservation programmes

tasks.statement: Inventory resource concerns on a farm or ranch with the landowner, recording soil, water, plant and animal conditions in the planning record
Write a conservation plan that schedules the practices, quantities and timing the landowner has agreed to install
Verify installed practices against design and practice standards before certifying them for programme payment

majorDuties.duty: Describe, test and sample soils in the field

tasks.statement: Classify soil horizons and profiles in the field to the applicable national soil classification system, documenting diagnostic features for each horizon
Describe a soil profile's horizons, colour, texture, structure and coarse fragments in standard terminology on the program's description form
Collect soil samples at specified depths and locations for laboratory analysis of texture, nutrients, carbon or contaminants
Estimate soil texture class by feel at each described horizon, recording the estimate for later comparison with laboratory results

majorDuties.duty: Install and maintain erosion control and watershed treatments

tasks.statement: Identify erosion-prone and actively eroding areas from field signs such as rills, gullies, pedestals and seeps, checking remote-sensed indications on the ground
Establish vegetated buffers or ground cover on exposed soils to the treatment specification before the next wet season
Compare erosion and sediment conditions at treated and untreated reference points across seasons, reporting whether treatments are working

majorDuties.duty: Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land

tasks.statement: Adjust field plans on a landowner's property to their access conditions, livestock, crops or concerns raised on the day, recording the change
Explain field findings and their limits face to face to landowners or community members on site, answering questions about methods and uncertainty
Conduct a joint field visit with a landowner or permittee, walking the site together and recording both parties' observations

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives
Relocate permanent plot monuments from recorded bearings and coordinates, re-establishing lost markers so repeat measurements stay comparable
Identify plants on sample plots to the protocol's required taxonomic level, collecting labelled vouchers for any plant not identified with certainty

majorDuties.duty: Assess species habitat requirements and habitat condition

tasks.statement: Measure habitat attributes such as cover, structure, water and forage at used and available sites following a habitat-use study protocol
Integrate habitat findings into land-use or project plans as specific measures that avoid or reduce effects on species of concern

majorDuties.duty: Design monitoring and sampling for valid environmental inference

tasks.statement: Choose the mix of field, sensor, remote-sensing and community methods for a monitoring programme from cost, detection and comparability evidence.

majorDuties.duty: Detect, treat and monitor invasive species in the field

tasks.statement: Treat invasive plants by mechanical, chemical or biological methods to the treatment prescription, protecting non-target vegetation and water
Select a control method for an infestation within integrated pest management, weighing efficacy, non-target risk, timing and follow-up capacity

majorDuties.duty: Administer environmental financial assistance to local governments

tasks.statement: Close out a financial assistance award, reconciling final costs, outcomes and compliance records against the award terms
Monitor funded projects' disbursements and milestones, withholding payment where required documentation or performance is missing

majorDuties.duty: Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data

tasks.statement: Maintain spatial layers of land use, vegetation and infrastructure with topology rules, attribute standards and update dates recorded.
Run spatial queries and overlays for an environmental assessment, checking that all layers share a coordinate reference system and compatible scales.
